text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your time as always! I'm 
Otonashi from Monthly Twinkle. Do you have 
a moment to spare?
choice_data_list:
What's the matter? Why so formal all of a 
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... No, it's just that I realized it's 
finally time for the final race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait, yet I feel a bit lonely... 
It's such a strange feeling.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry! What am I doing on such a 
momentous stage...! Now then, pulling 
myself together, let's begin the 
interview!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer of a leading contender for the 
"strongest" Umamusume! With the final race 
just ahead, how are you feeling?!

Deafening cheers. The fanfare will sound 
any moment now.

With the final match right before us, how 
are you feeling?!

Deafening cheers. The fanfare will sound 
any moment now.

I'll watch <chrname>'s run all the way to the very 
end. —Because to me, she is the 
"strongest"!
